(A) 1 (B) 2 (C) 3 (D) 4 (E) 5

solution.text:

A Ax = 0 implies 0 = x A Ax = ∥Ax∥ , hence Ax = 0; the converse is immediate. Both
nullspaces have dimension 5 − 2 = 3.
